2027 Hyundai Tucson Black Edition Comes Dark and Menacingly Stylish From Behind the CGI Curtain
11 photos
Photo: AutoYa Interior / YouTube
The South Korean automaker Hyundai has been very busy in November – mostly thanks to a couple of its most important and popular models, the all-new Elantra compact sedan and the Tucson compact crossover SUV.
The South Korean automaker has made it easier for all of us to track the modifications to the 2027MY lineup in the United States by compiling a list of changes for them earlier this month, confirming the arrival of both the all-new Tucson and the Elantra, plus the feisty Ioniq 6 N.
At the 2026 Los Angeles Auto Show, the attention was focused on the all-new eighth-generation 2027 Elantra and 2028 Elantra Hybrid, but the company also announced the all-new i30 Sedan for Australia, which is the local version of the global Elantra – and it will even supersede the Sonata, which is bowing out of the local market.
Back to North America, Hyundai recently announced the pricing for the Ioniq 6 N for the Canadian market, and the performance EV almost costs as much as a BMW M2 Coupe! In the United States, meanwhile, the South Korean company has revealed all the juicy details and full specifications (sans pricing) for the Tucson ICE and Hybrid, as well as the XRT PRO adventure version.
The all-new NX5 fifth-generation 2027 Hyundai Tucson ICE with the 1.6-liter turbo and 184 hp plus 195 lb.-ft. torque will arrive on the market during the first quarter of 2027, while the Hybrid model drops at dealerships sometimes early in the second quarter, with the 1.6-liter TMED-II Hybrid System packing a combined 233 hp and 280 lb-ft of torque, featuring a 1.49 kWh Li-Ion battery pack.
The company hasn’t discussed all the trim levels, focusing on the XRT PRO instead, as they kept such details in combination with the pricing information that is coming shortly before launch, so the rumor mill has decided to speculate for them instead about the lineup.
For example, the good folks over at the " AutoYa " info channel on YouTube have a satellite venue dubbed " AutoYa Interior ," which is where all the CGI Hyundai action resides, have imagined with help from their resident member of the imaginative guild of digital car content creators a potential 2027 Tucson Black Edition.
The host of the channel explains they have already worked on the new 5th generation Hyundai Tucson coming to the US market on several occasions, including a preview of many different color options, and now the resident virtual artist is back from across the parallel universes of vehicular CGI with the NX5 in a black-focused trim – and they illustrated the unofficial, hypothetical Black Edition design project for us.
The renderings showcase the 2027 Hyundai Tucson both in fancy and menacing all-black attire, but also in other colors that combine with black accents – both inside and outside. So, what do you think – yay or nay?
